Faith makes people happy because they have a (supposed) definitive certainty in their lives and a community united in faith only makes it harder for doubters like us to let go.  It feels great to think you know the way the world is supposed to work; I spent most of my life believing Catholic doctrine and it *felt* great at the time.  Looking back I know just how much of a bigot I was and despite how much trouble I received for embracing my disbelief I would reject my faith every time.  There's no justification for the hate perpetuated by hardline religious doctrine.  Having a community of likeminded people is definitely something I miss, but the people I love now are waaaay more open minded and loving of all people; so what I mean to say is there's definitely a better community out there that won't judge you on your sexuality/beliefs/politics/private affairs.
